error_resolution: Operating lease right-of-use assets ($1,346) were zeroed out and the amount was absorbed into Property and equipment, net ($3,914 → $5,260). ground_truth_citations.citation_rationale: ASC 842-20-45 requires lessees to present operating lease ROU assets either separately on the balance sheet or to disclose the line items that include them. Merging them into PP&E without disclosure violates this requirement.
